name: gohud
description: Build Godot 4.6+ game UI with gohud: menus, HUD bars, quick slots, joystick, dialogs, bottom sheets, forms, notices, coach marks, presets, JSON themes, skins and icon sets. Install: /plugin install gohud --marketplace thruthesky/gohud (Claude Code 2.1.275+). /gohud:preview launches the gallery or demo; /gohud:features explains every feature.
